title: What If You Built a Tower Out of Ice?
note: Illustrative example only. Every time is in seconds on the final video timeline. Words wrapped in *asterisks* in caption chunks are highlighted yellow.

voice.direction: Warm, curious narrator, brisk conversational pace.

beats.name: Hook: the problem
beats.visual: The hero object is already failing in the first second (wobbling, leaning, leaking).

lines.text: Stack blocks of ice into a tower, and it starts to wobble.

beats.name: Fix 1 (which will create the next problem)
beats.visual: Cutaway slices in. New parts snap into place one by one with a click and a ring flash.

lines.text: So you lock two supports underneath.

beats.name: Reveal + question
beats.visual: Pull back to the finished result, then one last cutaway glimpse.

lines.text: Now it stands on its own. Would you climb it?
